# requireCellGridRange

<link-summary>Returns the value as a single-cell range, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireCellGridRange() — Returns the value as a single-cell range, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireCellGridRange(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a grid range covering exactly one cell."
): GridRange;
```

One row and one column, measured by the bounds rather than by how the range was written: the end indices are exclusive, so a single cell is `endRowIndex - startRowIndex === 1` and the same for the columns. A range with a bound left out is open in that direction and is never a single cell.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                                     | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                                       | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a grid range covering exactly one cell."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`GridRange` — the same value, typed as a single-cell range.

## Throws

| Exception                   | Condition                             |
| :-------------------------- | :------------------------------------ |
| `InvalidGridRangeException` | the value is not a single-cell range. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
requireCellGridRange({ startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 1, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 1 }); // => { startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 1, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 1 }
requireCellGridRange({ startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 1 }); // throws InvalidGridRangeException
requireCellGridRange({}); // throws InvalidGridRangeException
```
